name: loaring-product-ops
description: Codex plugin for LoaRing product operations: Story intake, requirement analysis, API contracts, and implementation briefs.

interface.shortDescription: Work with LoaRing Stories, requirements, API contracts, and implementation briefs.
interface.longDescription: LoaRing Product Ops helps Codex read the product source of truth from loaring-product and turn it into Story drafts, requirement analysis, API contract updates, and role-specific implementation briefs without coupling backend and frontend repositories.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use LoaRing Product Ops to inspect product Stories, requirements, API contracts, and implementation boundaries before changing backend or frontend code.
